name: workbrain-extension

scripts.build: npm run tokens && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:dev: npm run tokens && tsc --noEmit && NODE_ENV=development vite build
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../dist.zip .
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run audit && npm run test && npm run build && npm run e2e && npm run a11y

//: Every runtime dependency needs a line in docs/DEPENDENCIES.md. There are two, and there is no good reason for a third.
